name: Raid Boss - Level 30
desc: His exploits are famous among Wererats. After assigning the South to the Sukar Wererats, he and a group of followers journeyed north in search of wealth. Unlike other Wererats, he possesses an enterprising spirit and began plundering the tombs of Orc tribal chiefs. Chased away by vengeful spirits, now he and his band rob unwary travelers passing through the region.

name: Raid Boss - Level 39
desc: Once a human magician with an almost Dwarven interest in machinery,he heard about Titan Age Sky Wagon Relic and theorized that a combination of Dwarven skills and magic could reproduce the flying wagon. He died without succeeding in his goal, but his spirit still wanders the area.

name: Raid Boss - Level 37
desc: This villain preys on adventurers who travel between the Dwarven Village and the Town of Schuttgart. He summoned all the northern Goblin powers to create a great bandit force and rule over them, but he made a serious mistake by stealing tribute intended for Schuttgart. Hearing rumors that the lord was preparing an army to clear out the bandits, he and his followers fled to the mountains.

name: Raid Boss - Level 53
desc: Once a shaman who worshipped Pa'agrio, he is now consumed by evil and bent on manipulating the powers of the spirit-being Tasha to conquer the world. His growing horde of followers include Ragna Orcs, evil spirits and insects.

name: Raid Boss - Level 52
desc: This powerful Chaos Golem was made from Starstones gathered from the Ruins of Pavel by the mad scientist Dr. Chaos, who styles himself the Emperor of Evil. Once a Golem Maestro, Dr. Chaos was expelled from the Black Anvil Guild for trying to steal the blueprint from the elders. He swore revenge on the Black Anvil Guild, conquering the Ruins of Pavel with the Horrifying Golem Army he created. He views all outsiders as assassins sent by the Guild and will attack immediately. His ultimate goal is “world domination.”

name: Raid Boss - Level 59
desc: This captain secretly loved the Princess Melissa. Saddened by her disappearance, he set out to learn her fate. Finding her transformed into the Ice Queen, Freya, he was turned into a Gargoyle and now protects the Frozen Labyrinth from interlopers.

name: Raid Boss - Level 80
desc: This Queen of Spike Stakatos conducts breeding experiments using top-ranking Spike Stakatos. She knows that her life running out and is desperately trying to grow a new Stakato queen in her nest, despite the low chances for success. Nursing her power, she dreams of a resurgence of her weakened race.

name: Raid Boss - Level 87
desc: Although he appears human, he is actually a high-ranking Angel who directly interacts with Einhasad and worships the Grail. Recently an ancient religious document found in the Tower of Insolence provided proof that the Grail is hidden in the Monastery of Silence. Since then, adherents of the Pagan Temple have frequently tried to steal it, but none has avoided the judgment of the Ruler of Splendor.

name: Raid Boss - Level 87
desc: This aristocrat of Rune secretly worships Triol, even conducting the occasional bloody worship ceremony in the Temple. Despite her claims of nobility, much of her background is still unknown.

name: Raid Boss - Level 73
desc: This Golem was originally a follower of Argos during the war between Giants and Humans. He remained with his master after Argos's imprisonment by Einhasad into the cliff wall. He has devolved to the point that he no longer resembles a Titan and isn't sure why he is still there. Even Daimon the White-Eyed cannot harm him in the Wall of Argos.

name: Raid Boss - Level 76
desc: The result of one of Hardin's magical experiments, he is rather monstrous in appearance, spewing lava from all over his body. Despite his looks, he was in fact a very submissive Golem who followed Hardin like a father. He went mad from the feeling of abandonment after Hardin left the Blazing Swamp. When King Astaire attacked Aden Castle, some of the soldiers of Elmore were caught in the Blazing Swamp, and there they first saw this giant covered in lava.

name: Raid Boss - Level 60
desc: The Ice Fairy who came to Freya after Princess Melissa was turned, she oversees everything in the Frozen Labyrinth on behalf of Freya. She has watched the movements of the Zinnia Guild ever since the Order of Canna Knights disappeared.
